known_gaps.new-root-entry-breaks-integrity: the lesson's own wording is 'Bramka integrity failuje na nowym root entry'; the Polish stem of the question ('integralności' -> integralnośc) does not reach the English token 'integrity' that the row uses. Lexical K1, no stemmer bridging PL/EN compounds. Pre-existing, not caused by ingest.
known_gaps.refuse-risotto: 'risotto alla milanese' shares an accidental token with the corpus. This is the accepted ceiling of lexical retrieval: 1 of 4 out-of-corpus questions is answered. Recorded, not hidden.
